# Build Guide: Ghoul Rifleman with Reverse Charge (and Pistols/Revolvers)

![Build Guide: Ghoul Rifleman with Reverse Charge (and Pistols/Revolvers)](/uploads/485_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Since March 18, 3035 you and your player can now become a ghoul and receive new perks and abilities. This has advantages and disadvantages. With the ghoul, a new mechanic has also been integrated into the live version of Fallout 76: **Onslaught**. This mechanic now also opens up completely new possibilities, both for ghouls and for humans.

This build for **rifle shooter** (single-shot rifles) allows you to play effectively with **pistols** in parallel. This is mainly because pistols received significant buffs to their base damage in the last update and can now be played without extra perk cards. However, you should be careful to use single-shot pistols or revolvers.

### Base: Ghoul Glow & Non-Wild

In this build we make sure that our Ghoul **Glow** (green life bar on the TP bar) is as full as possible. If the glow decreases, we use poisonous water or poisonous slime. You should always have enough of these with you and make them available on your speed bike. You can get poisonous water in many places, e.g. at the Blackwater Mine, Radiant Hills, Toxic Valley, etc. You can get toxic slime in West Tek and in small doses from the slime cooler (reward of this season 20).

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-ghoul-glow-bar.png)

It is also important not to go wild. Ferocity is represented by the bar above the AP bar at the bottom right. The fuller the bar, the less wild you are. The bar should therefore always be as full as possible. This can be achieved through **Chems** and "The Fix", although we currently only get a few of them in the Ghoul Quest. Tip: Psychobuff fills a lot of the bar.

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-ghoul-feral-bar.png)

## Armor

The armor is a Secret Service armor with the legendary mods: The Vanguard, AP Acceleration, Thru Hikers and on the 4th slot "Des Rangers". By using 5x Thru Hiker, the build saves the perk cards Travel First Aid Kit in Strength and Thru Hiker in Stamina.

Which armor you use is not important, the first mod can also be different. I thought Vanguard made sense. The radiation absorption from the environment is very low, so I prefer to use toxic slime to get radiation. Of course it is also possible e.g. a chameleon armor to further improve your stealth ability. Only Unyielding has no advantage here since you are not playing with low life. The radiation is absorbed immediately, so you cannot play as a ghoul in Bloodstain.

## Legendary Perks

- Aftermath **** (Ranged damage from sneak attacks increases damage taken by the target by 40 for 10 seconds)
- Full commitment **** (Enemies suffer 40% more damage when they attack you and you are in a team.) (Experience has shown that this legendary perk also stacks when you are hidden but the other team members are attacked, e.g. in events.)
- Legendary Strength **** (+5 STR and +5 STR skill points. Skill points are capped at 15)
- Legendary Intelligence **** (+5 INT and +5 INT skill points. Skill points are capped at 15)
- Legendary Agility **** (+5 ATOM and +5 ATOM skill points. Skill points are capped at 15)
- Legendary Luck **** (+5 Luck and +5 Luck skill points. Skill points are capped at 15)
